summary: Live high/critical scheduled ops hard-block via AutonomyEngine.gate_high_impact (shadow_ack + approval); dry-run remains preview-only; new shadow_ack param (#645/#879).
migration_impact: Live deploy/release/marketplace scheduled ops require shadow_ack from a prior simulate/dry-run (or approved checkpoint with shadow_id) plus approved=true. Dry-run path unchanged for obtaining shadow_id.
agent_notes: Always dry-run or plate_autonomy_simulate first; pass shadow_ack on live run_scheduled_op for high/critical. Do not treat approved=true alone as sufficient for live high-impact ops.
